source.text_snippet: Cystic fibrosis (CF) is a progressive, autosomal recessive disorder affecting the lungs, pancreas, and gastrointestinal tract [ 1 ]. It is caused by mutations in the CFTR gene, which impair chloride and bicarbonate ion transport, leading to mucus dehydration, airway obstruction, infection, and inflammation [ 2 , 3 ].
